services.name: Summer Camp
services.desc: Summer 2026 is right around the corner! Until then, keep dreaming of summer fun.The fresh air. The heat. The pool. The games. Friends, old and new. Campfire. S'MORES! The laughter - a lot of laughter.Each night we spend in beds at home is another day closer to sleeping under that perfect, clear, starry night sky. See you soon! Since 1941, Camp Natoma programs are ENTIRELY OUTDOORS and SCREEN-FREE,providing an excellent setting for personal growth and rejuvenation. services.name: Tour Camp Natoma
services.desc: Camp Natoma's Teen Leadership Program is a skill-building opportunity for teens who are ready to go beyond the standard "camper" experience. Participants take initiative, mentor younger campers, learn from staff, and join an awesome team working to make Camp special for everyone! The Teen Leadership Program prepares teens to be more than a camp counselor - teens complete the program with increased self-confidence, a toolbox of leadership skills, and an increased awareness of their impact on the world around them.
